data.long_meaning: Parvani is a Sanskrit and Hindu name derived from the word 'parvati'. It means 'maiden' or 'young girl'. In Hindu mythology, Parvati is the wife of Lord Shiva and is considered the goddess of love, beauty, fertility, and marriage. The name Parvani carries the meaning “Maiden, Young Girl” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Parvani usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, young girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name conveys a sense of youth, grace, and purity, which are highly valued traits in Indian society. Parvati is adored as a symbol of love, beauty, and marital bliss. The name Parvani also reflects the importance of the Hindu deities in shaping Indian culture and traditions.

The name Parvani holds tremendous spiritual significance as it represents the divine grace, love, and blessings of Parvati, the Hindu goddess. Carrying this name implies a deep connection to the spiritual essence of Hinduism, love, and the grace of the divine feminine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Parvani is a Sanskrit name, derived from the word 'Parvata' meaning mountain. It symbolizes strength, stability, and a deep connection to the earth. Parvani, as a divine feminine, embodies the nurturing and protective aspects of nature.
